title: Which top-level packaging containers, meaning those not contained within an
question: Which top-level packaging containers, meaning those not contained within any other packaging, have any item for which the total quantity accumulated across all nested levels in the hierarchy exceeds 500, and what are the names of both these containers and the corresponding items?

prediction.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE
top(id) AS (
  SELECT p.id
  FROM packaging p
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM packaging_relations r
    WHERE r.contains_id = p.id
  )
),
acc(top_id, item_id, total) AS (
  SELECT
    t.id,
    r.contains_id,
    r.qty
  FROM top t
  JOIN packaging_relations r ON r.packaging_id = t.id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    a.top_id,
    r.contains_id,
    a.total + r.qty
  FROM acc a
  JOIN packaging_relations r ON r.packaging_id = a.item_id
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  tp.name AS container_name,
  ip.name AS item_name
FROM acc a
JOIN packaging tp ON tp.id = a.top_id
JOIN packaging ip ON ip.id = a.item_id
WHERE a.total > 500
ORDER BY tp.name, ip.name;
